name: AI Illustrated News
description: Once a day, the top story of each of your feeds, summarised by an AI and drawn as a satirical ink cartoon (kie.ai, Gemini, Pollinations or HuggingFace). Shows one story at a time, poster style, moving to the next on each refresh.

cell_options.name: show_summary
cell_options.label: Summary
cell_options.help: The story's summary under the headline, where the cell has room for it.

cell_options.name: show_source
cell_options.label: Source and date
cell_options.help: The feed's label, the story's date and which story of how many.

settings.name: sources
settings.label: Sources
settings.help: One feed per line, as Label | feed address (RSS or Atom). Each feed gives one story a day: its newest. The label is the tag shown on the frame. Feedspot (rss.feedspot.com) lists good feeds by topic.

settings.name: run_at
settings.label: Time to make today's stories
settings.help: In the server's time zone. The stories are made at the first frame update after this time. For an exact time, turn on the placement's daily refresh at the same time.

settings.name: summary_words
settings.label: Summary length (words)
settings.help: About how long each summary is. Short articles get shorter summaries.

settings.name: summary_service
settings.label: Summaries by
settings.help: Groq writes a short summary of each article. Off shows the article's opening words instead.

settings.name: groq_api_key
settings.label: Groq API key
settings.help: Writes the summaries. Without it a story shows the opening words of the article.

settings.name: summary_prompt
settings.label: Summary prompt
settings.default: Summarize this news story in about {words} words. Use simple, plain language that anyone can understand. No jargon, no bullet points, no headers — just clear flowing sentences.
settings.help: {words} is the summary length. Rules against inventing facts are always added.

settings.name: provider_order
settings.label: Image provider order
settings.help: The image providers to use, first choice first, comma separated (kie, gemini, pollinations, huggingface), or none. The first picture wins; a story's picture has 150 seconds across all of them.

settings.name: image_prompt
settings.label: Illustration prompt
settings.help: For kie.ai and Gemini. {title}, {summary} and {shape} (the picture's shape, such as Tall portrait (9:16)) are filled in. Pollinations and HuggingFace get a short prompt of their own, which suits FLUX better.

settings.name: image_shape
settings.label: Picture shape

choices.label: Automatic: the shape of your frame

settings.help: Automatic draws pictures the shape of the biggest frame that showed this widget lately (9:16 until one has).

settings.name: caption_bg
settings.label: Gradient colour
settings.help: The band behind the text at the foot of the picture, fading upwards.

sample.title: Ukraine says Starlink connection 'now stable' after network limits
sample.summary: Ukraine's defence minister said the country now has a stable Starlink connection after days of limited satellite internet that hampered military operations.
